He is seeking an HR internship in talent acquisition, HR operations, onboarding, or people analytics to apply this knowledge in real work settings. He combines a practical, people-process first approach with structured spreadsheet tracking and careful, human-reviewed AI-aware methods.

### 8. AI Project Memory Architecture Framework
- **Category:** Innovation & Autonomous AI Systems Architecture
- **Role:** Lead Systems Architect & Framework Designer
- **Tech Stack:** Declarative Markdown Schema, YAML Subagent Permission Masks, Session Lifecycle Hooks (`AGENTS.md`), Multi-Agent Sandboxing.
- **Features:** Establishes a reproducible 3-pillar autonomous memory system:
  1. *Living Knowledge Base (`PROJECT_MEMORY.md`):* Human-auditable, git-versioned single source of truth at the repository root with standardized 4-section schema.
  2. *Sandboxed Subagent (`memory-keeper`):* Strict permission-masked agent with edit rights exclusively to `PROJECT_MEMORY.md`, zero git authority, and automated code-grounded drift audits.
  3. *Session Lifecycle Protocol:* Predictable execution hooks (Session Start drift check, Active task execution, Cascading domain updates, Session End fact recording).
  4. *Invariants & Setup:* 5 architecture invariants (Append-only rules, SSoT, strict sandboxing, zero-touch git, cross-IDE portability) and a 4-step setup recipe.
- **Documentation & Printable PDF:** https://nitishkashyapr.github.io/nitishkashyapr.com/projects/ai-project-memory-framework.html

## Technical & Professional Skills Matrix
- **HR & People Processes:** Talent acquisition support, screening coordination, onboarding checklists, candidate communication, employee engagement support, basic HR documentation, stakeholder follow-up, managing organizational change.
- **Tools & Platforms:** Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Google Forms & Workspace, MS Office, LinkedIn (basic sourcing), Notion, presentation & reporting.
- **Analysis & AI-Aware Productivity:** Structured problem solving, basic people reporting, research & synthesis, clear written communication, AI-assisted drafting (with mandatory human review), fast learning on new workflows.
- **Academic & Knowledge Disclosure:** Advanced HR topics such as compensation, employee relations, and performance systems are part of coursework and continuous learning. They are presented as knowledge areas, not independent full-time work experience.
